label: Both parents living, and proud
blurb: Your mother told the parish before you had told the vocation director.
outcome: You will be visited, fed, and prayed for. Your parents will be at every ordination and most first Masses, and they will get old on a schedule that does not consult the diocese's.

label: Your father is against it
blurb: He wanted grandchildren, or a partner in the business, or simply not this.
outcome: Every holiday is a negotiation and every milestone is one he may or may not attend. Your mother stands between you. You have already learned to hold a position under pressure at a kitchen table, which is most of what a chancery is.

label: A widowed mother, alone
blurb: Your father died. She has the house, her rosary, and you.
outcome: She is proud and she is alone, and someday she will be neither well nor near. When the best assignment of your life is offered, it may be three hundred miles from her, and the bishop will not consider that his problem.

label: A large family, the faith of the family
blurb: Five, six, seven children. A priest in the family is expected, and you are the one.
outcome: There will always be a nephew to baptize and a sister to call. You will never be short of people who think they own a piece of your vocation, and you will never be short of people who show up.

label: Not much contact
blurb: Divorce, distance, a falling-out no one will name. You send a card at Christmas.
outcome: No one will visit and no one will need you, which is a kind of freedom the other men will quietly envy until they see what it costs at Christmas. The Church will be the only family you have, and it is not a good one.

label: A sibling who depends on you
blurb: A brother or sister with a disability, an addiction, or a life that keeps coming apart. You are the one who answers the phone.
outcome: You will be pulled out of a chapel by a phone call more than once. It will make you patient with the people who fall apart in your parishes, and it will make you late to things that matter to the chancery.
